vgc-reg-h-balance.name: 🏆 VGC Reg H Championship Balance
vgc-reg-h-balance.description: Standard tournament balance core pivoting with Intimidate, Grassy Surge, and high burst offense.
vgc-reg-h-balance.notes: Lead Incineroar + Rillaboom for double pivot and Fake Out tempo. Archaludon and Primarina apply heavy field pressure.

vgc-rain-offense.name: 🌧️ VGC Pelipper Rain & Swift Swim
vgc-rain-offense.description: Drizzle powers up Water moves and activates Archaludon's Stamina and Electro Shot in 1 turn.
vgc-rain-offense.notes: Lead Pelipper + Archaludon. Basculegion-Male sweeps late-game with boosted Adaptability Wave Crash.

vgc-hard-trick-room.name: 🌀 VGC Hard Trick Room & Bloodmoon
vgc-hard-trick-room.description: Farigiraf Armor Tail prevents opposing priority (Fake Out, Taunt, Grassy Glide) allowing guaranteed Trick Room.
vgc-hard-trick-room.notes: Farigiraf sets Trick Room while Indeedee-Female provides Follow Me redirection. Ursaluna-Bloodmoon wipes boards.

vgc-tailwind-hyper-offense.name: 💨 VGC Whimsicott Tailwind Hyper Offense
vgc-tailwind-hyper-offense.description: Prankster Tailwind doubles speed instantly, enabling Garchomp, Dragonite, and Gholdengo to overwhelm before opposing setup.
vgc-tailwind-hyper-offense.notes: Lead Whimsicott + Garchomp or Gholdengo. Encore locks passive foes into Protect or setup moves.

vgc-snow-veil-offense.name: ❄️ VGC Alolan Ninetales Snow & Veil
vgc-snow-veil-offense.description: Snow Warning sets snow, boosting Ice-types' Defense by 50% and enabling 1-turn Aurora Veil.
vgc-snow-veil-offense.notes: Lead Alolan Ninetales + Baxcalibur. Dual screens make Baxcalibur almost unbreakable while Thermal Exchange prevents burns.

vgc-dondozo-commander.name: 🐟 VGC Dondozo Commander Setup
vgc-dondozo-commander.description: Tatsugiri Commander boosts all of Dondozo's stats by +2 stages, creating a dominant raid boss.
vgc-dondozo-commander.notes: Position Dondozo + Tatsugiri. Clear opposing Grass and Electric counters before commanding.

vgc-sun-room-offense.name: ☀️ VGC Torkoal Sun & Chlorophyll Room
vgc-sun-room-offense.description: Drought powers up Fire moves, activates Venusaur Chlorophyll, and triggers Solar Power Charizard.
vgc-sun-room-offense.notes: Fast sun mode with Chlorophyll Venusaur; slow sun mode with Torkoal + Farigiraf Trick Room.

vgc-psyspam-expanding-force.name: 🔮 VGC Psyspam Expanding Force
vgc-psyspam-expanding-force.description: Psychic Terrain blocks all priority moves while Expanding Force hits both opposing targets with 1.5x power.
vgc-psyspam-expanding-force.notes: Lead Indeedee-Female + Armarouge. Follow Me diverts attacks while Expanding Force cleanses the board.

vgc-whimsicott-beat-up.name: 🥊 VGC Beat Up Annihilape Rage Fist
vgc-whimsicott-beat-up.description: Whimsicott or Maushold uses Beat Up on ally Annihilape, maxing Rage Fist to 250+ base power in turn 1.
vgc-whimsicott-beat-up.notes: Lead Whimsicott + Annihilape or Maushold + Annihilape. Maushold Friend Family provides Follow Me redirection.

vgc-clefairy-friend-guard.name: 🛡️ VGC Friend Guard Bulky Goodstuff
vgc-clefairy-friend-guard.description: Clefairy Friend Guard reduces damage taken by allies by 25%, letting Ursaluna and Kommo-o freely set up.
vgc-clefairy-friend-guard.notes: Clefairy redirects with Follow Me and boosts offensive partners with Helping Hand.

vgc-palafin-hero-balance.name: 🐬 VGC Palafin Hero Form Pivot
vgc-palafin-hero-balance.description: Palafin switches out immediately with Flip Turn to transform into Hero form with 160 base Attack.
vgc-palafin-hero-balance.notes: Lead Palafin-Zero + Incineroar. Once transformed, Palafin's Jet Punch executes high-priority revenge kills.

vgc-sand-stream-rush.name: 🏜️ VGC Tyranitar & Excadrill Sand Rush
vgc-sand-stream-rush.description: Tyranitar Sand Stream boosts Rock-type SpD by 50% and doubles Excadrill's Speed via Sand Rush.
vgc-sand-stream-rush.notes: Excadrill outspeeds the entire unboosted metagame under sand. Salamence Intimidate supports physical bulk.

vgc-glimmora-toxic-debris.name: 🪨 VGC Glimmora Toxic Debris & Pressure
vgc-glimmora-toxic-debris.description: Glimmora sets Toxic Spikes upon taking physical hits and threatens heavy spread damage with Sludge Wave.
vgc-glimmora-toxic-debris.notes: Lead Glimmora + Amoonguss or Incineroar. Hydreigon provides fast dragon coverage and Dark Pulse flinches.

vgc-reg-h-grass-pledge.name: 🌿 VGC Grass-Water Pledge Swamp
vgc-reg-h-grass-pledge.description: Combining Grass Pledge and Water Pledge creates a swamp that quarters the opponent's Speed for 4 turns.
vgc-reg-h-grass-pledge.notes: Lead Rillaboom + Primarina to set the swamp immediately, neutralizing fast opposing threats.

vgc-volcarona-quiver-dance.name: 🦋 VGC Volcarona Redirection & Setup
vgc-volcarona-quiver-dance.description: Volcarona sets up Quiver Dance behind Maushold Follow Me redirection, becoming an unstoppable special sweeper.
vgc-volcarona-quiver-dance.notes: Flame Body punishes physical multi-hit moves. Annihilape provides physical wallbreaking synergy.

bss-dragonite-kingambit-core.name: 🐉 BSS Dragonite + Kingambit Premier Core
bss-dragonite-kingambit-core.description: The quintessential singles core: Dragonite breaks and cleans, while Kingambit's Supreme Overlord secures the endgame.
bss-dragonite-kingambit-core.notes: Multiscale allows Dragonite to live any hit and set up Dragon Dance. Gliscor absorbs status and sets hazards.

bss-bloodmoon-trick-room.name: 🐻 BSS Bloodmoon Ursaluna + Mimikyu TR
bss-bloodmoon-trick-room.description: Mimikyu's Disguise guarantees Trick Room execution against all single-hit attacks.
bss-bloodmoon-trick-room.notes: Bloodmoon Ursaluna has unmatched raw power under Trick Room with unblockable Normal/Ground coverage.

bss-gliscor-clodsire-hazard.name: 🏺 BSS Gliscor + Clodsire Hazard Stack
bss-gliscor-clodsire-hazard.description: Sets Spikes and Toxic Spikes to wear down opposing teams while Corviknight and Clodsire form an impenetrable defensive wall.
bss-gliscor-clodsire-hazard.notes: Corviknight Defogs and checks physical attackers; Clodsire handles special threats with Unaware.

bss-gliscor-toxic-stall.name: 🦂 BSS Gliscor Poison Heal Stall
bss-gliscor-toxic-stall.description: The ultimate defensive endurance team: Poison Heal Gliscor, Unaware Dondozo, and Blissey absorb everything.
bss-gliscor-toxic-stall.notes: Dondozo ignores all stat-boosting sweepers; Blissey walls special attackers; Gliscor stalls out PP.

bss-volcarona-quiver-dance.name: 🦋 BSS Volcarona Quiver Dance Sweeper
bss-volcarona-quiver-dance.description: Volcarona sets up Quiver Dance to boost SpA, SpD, and Speed simultaneously, sweeping unprepared teams.
bss-volcarona-quiver-dance.notes: Garchomp and Kingambit pressure opposing Rock and Water counters before Volcarona enters.

bss-dondozo-unaware-wall.name: 🐟 BSS Dondozo Unaware RestTalk
bss-dondozo-unaware-wall.description: Dondozo ignores opposing Swords Dance and Dragon Dance, winning 1v1 wars with Rest and Sleep Talk.
bss-dondozo-unaware-wall.notes: Clodsire and Corviknight cover Dondozo's Electric and Grass weaknesses seamlessly.

bss-dragapult-screens-ho.name: 👻 BSS Dragapult Dual Screens HO
bss-dragapult-screens-ho.description: Lead Dragapult sets Reflect and Light Screen with 142 base Speed, allowing Volcarona and Kingambit to set up safely.
bss-dragapult-screens-ho.notes: Curse on Mimikyu breaks stall; Kingambit cleans in the endgame under remaining screen turns.

bss-mimikyu-curse-sweeper.name: 🧸 BSS Mimikyu Disguise & Trick Room
bss-mimikyu-curse-sweeper.description: Mimikyu sets Trick Room and uses Curse to bring itself down while inflicting residual damage, passing to Bloodmoon.
bss-mimikyu-curse-sweeper.notes: Ursaluna-Bloodmoon and Torkoal form a terrifying offensive Trick Room double core.

bss-scarf-gholdengo-trick.name: 🪙 BSS Scarf Gholdengo Trick & Pivot
bss-scarf-gholdengo-trick.description: Choice Scarf Gholdengo outspeeds opposing threats and uses Trick to cripple walls like Clodsire and Dondozo.
bss-scarf-gholdengo-trick.notes: Rillaboom and Incineroar provide constant pivoting and Grassy Terrain recovery.

bss-sneasler-unburden-sweep.name: 🥊 BSS Sneasler Grassy Seed Unburden
bss-sneasler-unburden-sweep.description: Rillaboom summons Grassy Terrain, consuming Sneasler's Grassy Seed to double its speed via Unburden.
bss-sneasler-unburden-sweep.notes: Swords Dance on the seed boost turn makes Sneasler nearly impossible to check physically.

bss-archaludon-stamina-press.name: 🌉 BSS Archaludon Stamina Body Press
bss-archaludon-stamina-press.description: Rain boosts Archaludon's Electro Shot and enables Barraskewda and Basculegion to blitz teams.
bss-archaludon-stamina-press.notes: Archaludon's Stamina turns opposing physical hits into Body Press offensive buffs.

bss-baxcalibur-snow-sweep.name: ❄️ BSS Baxcalibur Thermal Exchange
bss-baxcalibur-snow-sweep.description: Alolan Ninetales sets Aurora Veil, allowing Baxcalibur to Dragon Dance and sweep with Loaded Dice Icicle Spear.
bss-baxcalibur-snow-sweep.notes: Thermal Exchange gives Baxcalibur free Attack boosts against Will-O-Wisp and Fire attacks.

bss-skeledirge-unaware-torch.name: 🐊 BSS Skeledirge Unaware Torch Song
bss-skeledirge-unaware-torch.description: Unaware Skeledirge boosts its Special Attack on every Torch Song while nullifying opponent offensive setup.
bss-skeledirge-unaware-torch.notes: Garchomp and Corviknight form the defensive backbone, providing Spikes and physical stopping power.

bss-meowscarada-spikes-lead.name: 🐱 BSS Meowscarada Protean Hazard Lead
bss-meowscarada-spikes-lead.description: Meowscarada lays Spikes, knocks off items, and lands guaranteed critical hits with Flower Trick.
bss-meowscarada-spikes-lead.notes: Gholdengo blocks opposing Rapid Spin and Defog, preserving hazard control for Kingambit to clean.

bss-sun-chlorophyll-offense.name: ☀️ BSS Sun Chlorophyll Sweeper
bss-sun-chlorophyll-offense.description: Torkoal sets Drought, enabling Chlorophyll Venusaur and Scovillain to double speed and out-speed the entire meta.
bss-sun-chlorophyll-offense.notes: Volcarona gains a 50% power boost to Fire moves under Sun. Dragonite covers Ground/Rock counters.

dou-chienpao-dragonite-espeed.name: ⚔️ DOU Chien-Pao Sword of Ruin + E-Speed
dou-chienpao-dragonite-espeed.description: Sword of Ruin drops opposing physical defense by 25%, letting Tera Normal Extreme Speed dismantle teams.
dou-chienpao-dragonite-espeed.notes: Lead Chien-Pao + Dragonite. Extreme Speed bypasses speed control and strikes before Protect or redirection.

dou-pelipper-basculegion-rain.name: 🌧️ DOU Pelipper + Basculegion Swift Swim
dou-pelipper-basculegion-rain.description: Basculegion Swift Swim Wave Crash in rain delivers unmatched physical burst damage.
dou-pelipper-basculegion-rain.notes: Last Respects cleans up late-game if teammates have fainted. Archaludon absorbs electric attacks.

dou-torkoal-chiyu-sun.name: ☀️ DOU Torkoal + Chi-Yu Beads of Ruin
dou-torkoal-chiyu-sun.description: Chi-Yu Beads of Ruin combined with Sun-boosted Heat Waves overwhelms even resistant switch-ins.
dou-torkoal-chiyu-sun.notes: Walking Wake Hydro Steam gains 1.5x power under Sun instead of being weakened. Ogerpon breaks flash fire.

dou-ursaluna-guts-trick-room.name: 🌀 DOU Ursaluna Flame Orb Guts TR
dou-ursaluna-guts-trick-room.description: Flame Orb activates Guts for a 50% Attack boost, unleashing devastating Facade and Headlong Rush.
dou-ursaluna-guts-trick-room.notes: Diancie sets Trick Room and Diamond Storm to raise team Defense. Indeedee-F redirects attacks.

dou-tornadus-tailroom-balance.name: 💨 DOU Tornadus + Farigiraf TailRoom
dou-tornadus-tailroom-balance.description: TailRoom hybrid speed control: fast mode via Tailwind, slow counter-mode via Trick Room.
dou-tornadus-tailroom-balance.notes: Farigiraf Armor Tail denies Fake Out and Grassy Glide. Urshifu and Bloodmoon clean under both speeds.

dou-rillaboom-heatran-core.name: 🌿 DOU Rillaboom + Heatran Grassy Core
dou-rillaboom-heatran-core.description: Grassy Terrain weakens Earthquake by 50%, eliminating Heatran's 4x Ground weakness while providing passive recovery.
dou-rillaboom-heatran-core.notes: Heatran Magma Storm traps and melts grass resists. Rillaboom U-turns into Landorus to cycle Intimidate.

dou-psyspam-expanding-force.name: 🔮 DOU Psyspam Expanding Force
dou-psyspam-expanding-force.description: Psychic Terrain blocks all priority moves while Expanding Force hits both opposing targets with 1.5x power.
dou-psyspam-expanding-force.notes: Armarouge and Chi-Yu unleash devastating spread attacks while Indeedee-F provides redirection.

dou-ninetales-kyurem-snow.name: ❄️ DOU Alolan Ninetales + Kyurem Snow
dou-ninetales-kyurem-snow.description: Aurora Veil and Snow Defense boosts make Kyurem an impervious special wallbreaker with Blizzard.
dou-ninetales-kyurem-snow.notes: Snow boosts Ice types' Defense by 50%. 100% accurate Blizzard hits both opposing slots.

dou-iron-hands-heavy-slam.name: 🥊 DOU Iron Hands Heavy Slam Pivot
dou-iron-hands-heavy-slam.description: Massive bulk with Assault Vest, Fake Out tempo control, and max power Heavy Slam against lightweight sweepers.
dou-iron-hands-heavy-slam.notes: Cycle Fake Out with Tornadus Tailwind and Landorus U-turn to control match tempo.

dou-walking-wake-hydro-steam.name: 🌊 DOU Walking Wake Hydro Steam Sun
dou-walking-wake-hydro-steam.description: Hydro Steam gains a 50% power boost under Sun instead of being reduced, catching fire teams off guard.
dou-walking-wake-hydro-steam.notes: Torkoal Drought enables Protosynthesis Speed or Sp. Atk boost on Walking Wake without consuming Booster Energy.

dou-gholdengo-make-it-rain.name: 🪙 DOU Gholdengo Nasty Plot + Tailwind
dou-gholdengo-make-it-rain.description: Good as Gold makes Gholdengo completely immune to all status and stat debuffs while setting Nasty Plot.
dou-gholdengo-make-it-rain.notes: Murkrow Prankster Tailwind + Haze clears opposing stat boosts and resets Gholdengo Sp. Atk drops.

dou-diancie-diamond-storm-tr.name: 💎 DOU Diancie Diamond Storm TR
dou-diancie-diamond-storm-tr.description: Diamond Storm has a 50% chance to boost Defense by +2, turning Diancie into an impenetrable fortress in Trick Room.
dou-diancie-diamond-storm-tr.notes: Ursaluna and Kingambit form a terrifying physical offense core under 5 turns of Trick Room.

dou-ogerpon-cornerstone-sturdy.name: 🪨 DOU Ogerpon-Cornerstone Sturdy Core
dou-ogerpon-cornerstone-sturdy.description: Sturdy guarantees surviving any single hit, allowing Ivy Cudgel rock coverage and Follow Me redirection.
dou-ogerpon-cornerstone-sturdy.notes: Terastallize into Embody Aspect to raise Defense by +1, locking down physical sweepers.

dou-sinistcha-hospitality-bulk.name: 🍵 DOU Sinistcha Hospitality Pivot
dou-sinistcha-hospitality-bulk.description: Hospitality restores 25% of partner's maximum HP on every switch-in, keeping bulky sweepers alive indefinitely.
dou-sinistcha-hospitality-bulk.notes: Matcha Gotcha damages both opponents with a 20% burn chance while healing Sinistcha.

dou-annihilape-beat-up.name: 👻 DOU Beat Up Annihilape Rage Fist
dou-annihilape-beat-up.description: Beat Up activates Defiant or stacks 5 hits onto Annihilape, raising Rage Fist to 300 base power.
dou-annihilape-beat-up.notes: Maushold Friend Guard reduces incoming damage by 25% while redirecting attacks with Follow Me.

ou-hazard-stack-ho.name: ⚡ Smogon OU Fast Hazard Stack & Sweep
ou-hazard-stack-ho.description: Suicide hazard lead Glimmora lays Toxic Debris and Stealth Rock, enabling Kingambit and Iron Valiant cleanups.
ou-hazard-stack-ho.notes: Lead Glimmora to set entry hazards. Spinblock with Dragapult and use Kingambit as supreme endgame cleaner.

ou-balanced-core-pivots.name: 🛡️ Smogon OU Balance & Regenerator Pivot
ou-balanced-core-pivots.description: Standard OU tournament balance utilizing Chilly Reception pivot with Ting-Lu hazards and Kingambit.
ou-balanced-core-pivots.notes: Slowking-Galar uses Chilly Reception to set Snow and bring in offensive sweepers without taking damage.

ou-hyper-rain-offense.name: 🌧️ Smogon OU Pelipper Barraskewda Rain
ou-hyper-rain-offense.description: Relentless Drizzle offense pairing Barraskewda's Swift Swim with Walking Wake and Archaludon.
ou-hyper-rain-offense.notes: Barraskewda outspeeds the entire tier in Rain. Archaludon Stamina and Electro Shot provide bulk.

ou-big-stall-passive.name: 🧱 Smogon OU Clodsire & Dondozo Big Stall
ou-big-stall-passive.description: Impenetrable defensive wall with dual Unaware (Clodsire + Dondozo) and Gliscor Toxic Spikes.
ou-big-stall-passive.notes: Dondozo handles physical sweepers; Clodsire handles special sweepers; Blissey walls special attackers.

ou-grimmsnarl-dual-screens.name: 🔮 Smogon OU Grimmsnarl Dual Screens
ou-grimmsnarl-dual-screens.description: Prankster Reflect and Light Screen cut all damage in half, enabling booster sweepers to set up freely.
ou-grimmsnarl-dual-screens.notes: Grimmsnarl sets screens and Parting Shots into Gouging Fire or Roaring Moon for safe Dragon Dance setups.

ou-torkoal-walking-wake-sun.name: ☀️ Smogon OU Protosynthesis Sun
ou-torkoal-walking-wake-sun.description: Torkoal Drought enables Protosynthesis boosts for Walking Wake, Roaring Moon, and Gouging Fire.
ou-torkoal-walking-wake-sun.notes: Great Tusk controls entry hazards under Sun while gaining an automatic Protosynthesis Speed boost.

ou-ninetales-veil-baxcalibur.name: ❄️ Smogon OU Aurora Veil Snow
ou-ninetales-veil-baxcalibur.description: Alolan Ninetales sets Snow and Aurora Veil, turning Baxcalibur and Iron Valiant into tanky sweepers.
ou-ninetales-veil-baxcalibur.notes: Snow boosts Baxcalibur's defense by 50% while Veil reduces incoming damage by half.

ou-ribombee-sticky-web.name: 🕸️ Smogon OU Ribombee Sticky Web HO
ou-ribombee-sticky-web.description: Sticky Web lowers incoming grounded Pokémon Speed by 1 stage, allowing heavy wallbreakers to sweep unimpeded.
ou-ribombee-sticky-web.notes: Ribombee leads with Sticky Web and Stun Spore. Gholdengo prevents rapid spin and defog hazard removal.

ou-tyranitar-excadrill-sand.name: ⏳ Smogon OU Sand Rush Excadrill
ou-tyranitar-excadrill-sand.description: Sand Stream gives Rock types +50% Special Defense while Sand Rush doubles Excadrill's Speed.
ou-tyranitar-excadrill-sand.notes: Excadrill sweeps with Swords Dance and Earthquake under Sand. Corviknight and Slowking form the defensive backbone.

ou-ting-lu-spikes-phaze.name: 🏺 Smogon OU Ting-Lu Spikes & Whirlwind
ou-ting-lu-spikes-phaze.description: Ting-Lu sets 3 layers of Spikes and forces switches via Whirlwind, dealing up to 25% on every opponent entry.
ou-ting-lu-spikes-phaze.notes: Gholdengo blocks Court Change and Defog. Dragapult pivots and revenge kills.

ou-volcarona-quiver-dance.name: 🦋 Smogon OU Bulky Volcarona QD
ou-volcarona-quiver-dance.description: Quiver Dance boosts Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed simultaneously, making Volcarona nearly unstoppable once hazards are cleared.
ou-volcarona-quiver-dance.notes: Always preserve Heavy-Duty Boots. Use Fiery Dance to stack further Sp. Atk boosts while attacking.

ou-ogerpon-wellspring-pivot.name: 💧 Smogon OU Ogerpon-Wellspring Balance
ou-ogerpon-wellspring-pivot.description: Water Absorb allows Ogerpon-Wellspring to switch freely into opposing rain, surging strikes, and water moves.
ou-ogerpon-wellspring-pivot.notes: Encore locks opponents into setup or recovery moves, allowing free Swords Dance turns.

ou-gliscor-toxic-protect.name: 🦂 Smogon OU Gliscor Toxic Spikes Protect
ou-gliscor-toxic-protect.description: Immunity to status once poisoned by Toxic Orb, creating infinite Protect + Substitute recovery loops.
ou-gliscor-toxic-protect.notes: Lays Toxic Spikes and Spikes. Dondozo and Corviknight absorb physical wallbreakers.

ou-cinderace-court-change.name: ⚽ Smogon OU Cinderace Court Change Pivot
ou-cinderace-court-change.description: Court Change steals all opposing entry hazards (Stealth Rock, Spikes, Webs) and puts them on the opponent's side.
ou-cinderace-court-change.notes: Pyro Ball deals massive fire damage while Libero grants STAB to high jump kick and gunk shot.

ou-hatterene-crawdaunt-tr.name: 🌀 Smogon OU Crawdaunt & Ursaluna TR
ou-hatterene-crawdaunt-tr.description: Magic Bounce Hatterene sets Trick Room and prevents Taunt or hazards, enabling Crawdaunt's Adaptability Crabhammer.
ou-hatterene-crawdaunt-tr.notes: Crawdaunt with Adaptability water and dark moves 2HKOs nearly the entire OU tier under Trick Room.

sample_1792608052620.name: Mega Golisopod
sample_1792608052620.author: Trainer Custom
sample_1792608052620.notes: Archaludon's Stamina turns opposing physical hits into Body Press offensive buffs.
